searchText: Hi, new here! 🙂 Is there a rust CLI yet? I've seen rust libs, and go and java CLIs, but not a rust CLI. I'd be interested to work on one to increase diversity. And maybe walk through the code at a technical eth meetup and run it there, and contribute to the awareness and trust in the ceremony and the final setup. I had created one a while back here: https://github.com/crate-crypto/kzg-ceremony-cli It doesn’t include double signing though Thanks! I'll look at it. Gm! Just applied to the grants round. We're trying to understand the best way to air gap the computer but still make the commitment. Does anyone have direction or resources for us? <CarlBeek> no resources yet, but i’ll type something up soon. (tm) but for unique contributions, you’ll be allocated a time slot to participate proportional to how much time you should need. as an example: if the idea is to generate it inside an abandoned cave and you’ll need 3 hrs to get down and up, we’ll arrange a 4 hour slot for you to do everything.
